description: Cental Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancellation of the Finance Business Licence issued to MCSL Financial Services Ltd., with effect from 01.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the cancellation of a finance business license under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011 by the Monetary Board. This constitutes a regulatory action and falls under legal/regulatory matters concerning financial institution regulations and compliance requirements, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory).
